description.zh: 剧本梗概：用户针对该剧本进行简短的故事说明
description.en: Script summary. Provide a brief story description for the script.

description.zh: 剧本类型关键词：用户针对该剧本类型进行定性描述，如历史架空、科幻、爱情、玄幻等描述
description.en: Script type keywords. Provide qualitative descriptions for the script type, such as historical fantasy, sci-fi, romance, or Xuanhuan.

description.zh: 上文补充描述：用户针对某一段小说内容续写，需要用户提供上文补充
description.en: Preceding text description. Continue a section of novel content. Provide the preceding text.

title.zh: 影视互娱剧本创作-剧本续写
title.en: Script Continuation for Film, TV, and Entertainment

descriptions.zh: 根据用户输入剧本上文描述，即可快速生产下文，扩展编辑人员续写思路。
descriptions.en: This feature generates the next part of a script based on the preceding text. This helps expand the creative ideas of editors.
